title: Detailed cherries
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='cherry1' cx='38%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8a8a'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#e8202a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8f0d18'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='cherry2' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9a90'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#e02a30'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7d0a16'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='stem' cx='30%' cy='20%' r='90%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#9fe07a'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#4f9a34'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2d5f1c'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='leaf' cx='35%' cy='30%' r='80%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#a8e87e'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#5cb03a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#357a20'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- stems -->
  <path d='M46 60 C40 44 36 30 34 18' stroke='url(#stem)' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 60 C60 42 58 28 52 16' stroke='url(#stem)' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- leaf -->
  <path d='M52 16 C58 8 74 6 82 14 C72 16 62 18 52 16 Z' fill='url(#leaf)' stroke='#7cc455' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M56 15 C64 11 72 11 78 14' stroke='#a8e87e' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- knot joining stems -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='21' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#3f7f28' stroke='#7cc455' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- left cherry -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='70' r='19' fill='url(#cherry1)'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='60' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#ffe1e1' opacity='0.75' transform='rotate(-30 28 60)'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='82' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#5c0a12' opacity='0.45'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='64' r='3' fill='#a3183f'/><circle cx='47' cy='61' r='2' fill='#a3183f'/><circle cx='50' cy='57' r='2.5' fill='#a3183f'/>
  <circle cx='51.5' cy='64.5' r='1.2' fill='#e86a80'/><circle cx='47.5' cy='61.5' r='0.9' fill='#e86a80'/>

  <!-- right cherry -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='74' r='17' fill='url(#cherry2)'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='65' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ffe4e0' opacity='0.75' transform='rotate(-30 59 65)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='85' rx='8' ry='4.5' fill='#5c0a12' opacity='0.45'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='68' r='3' fill='#a3183f'/><circle cx='55' cy='64' r='2' fill='#a3183f'/><circle cx='50' cy='72' r='2.5' fill='#a3183f'/>
  <circle cx='51.5' cy='68.5' r='1.2' fill='#e86a80'/><circle cx='55.5' cy='64.5' r='0.9' fill='#e86a80'/>

  <!-- tiny highlights on stems -->
  <path d='M42 52 L44 40' stroke='#c8f0a8' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 50 L56 36' stroke='#c8f0a8' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
